title: Source, period and consumer coverage
inputs: Source inventory, effective source hashes, issuer/perimeter/period coverage, source-to-module map (T1–T4, T6, T8; P3/P5).
guard: Read/parsed is not verified; show excluded, stale, unreadable and absent separately. Count unique sources, not warning strings.

title: Readiness and blocking gaps
inputs: T5/T7 readiness and gaps; selected downstream consumers and exact blocking reasons.
guard: Use producer readiness states and word+shape; no financial score from module completion.

title: Source chronology and supersession
inputs: Document publication, reporting period, revision/amendment dates and authority.
guard: Publication date, reporting period and import timestamp are different. Unknown dates stay unplaced.

title: Total and net leverage
inputs: CP-1 typed S.1 producer coordinates, debt/EBITDA basis, date/period and fact references.
guard: Show only comparable periods and definitions; no interpolation across missing periods; exact amounts remain in the table.
placement: FP01 model strip; FP02 metric strip

title: Interest coverage
inputs: Typed S.2; stated coverage definitions, debt-only/lease-inclusive series when supplied.
guard: Never merge cash interest, total interest or lease-adjusted denominators.

title: Cash and accessible liquidity
inputs: Typed S.3; cash and total accessible-liquidity observations with accessibility restrictions.
guard: Known cash is not automatically accessible cash. The current producer uses lines; the design is reused without inventing a revolver series.

title: Debt maturity wall
inputs: Typed S.4; T4.18 facilities/claim amounts, final maturities, currency and debt categories.
guard: Keep principal versus carrying amount distinct; undrawn commitments are not funded maturities; undated facilities have a separate bucket. Reuse the same figure in FP04.

title: Revenue and adjusted EBITDA history
inputs: Typed S.5; cited revenue and the specified EBITDA measure by comparable period.
guard: Maintain reported versus issuer-adjusted versus house-adjusted identities; no mixed-duration trend. Current binding places S.5 in FP01 only.

title: Debt ranking and cumulative leverage
inputs: Facility balances, ranking/security, guarantor/obligor scope, common EBITDA denominator; EV only when supplied.
guard: The SVG debt-stack primitive exists, but no S.6 producer is registered. Require legal rank and a positive denominator; EV is not a sourced fact merely because it is a chart marker.

title: EBITDA adjustment bridge
inputs: T4.17 bridge from reported measure to specified adjusted measure, signed adjustments and reconciliation.
guard: EU.3 is a design requirement, not a current bound figure. Totals must reconcile; do not manufacture intermediate adjustments from endpoints. CP-1D supplies a separate challenge view.

title: Financial statements and calculation lineage
inputs: T4.4–T4.6, T4.8–T4.10, T4.15–T4.19 and source/calculation trace.
guard: Preserve instants versus durations, restatements, quantity family, scale and currency. Current S.1–S.5 consumer has a USD unit whitelist; qualify non-USD adapters instead of relabelling data.

title: Issuer event history and transaction calendar
inputs: events_timeline, transaction_summary; actual event date/precision/status, parties and cited handoff lines.
guard: The event information is already required; the graphical timeline is new. Separate announced, completed, cancelled and subsequent events; never fold a later payment into an earlier financial period.

title: Ownership and control
inputs: ownership_register; owner/class, economic interest, control rights, dates and evidence.
guard: Undisclosed percentages stay unknown; ownership, legal control and guarantees use different labelled edges. No inferred sponsor willingness.

title: Business mix and concentration
inputs: revenue_business_mix; aligned CP-1 T4.16 segment/end-market amounts or explicit sourced shares.
guard: Do not force partial coverage to 100%; labels without quantities stay a qualitative map. Keep periods, currencies and consolidation boundaries aligned.

title: Operating model and credit transmission
inputs: operating_model and credit_translation: evidence → mechanism → credit implication.
guard: Edges must be stated in the handoff and tagged Documentary Fact, Management Language, Analyst Interpretation or Insufficient Information. No weighted cash-flow arrows without amounts.

title: Governance, sponsor behaviour and capital allocation
inputs: T2D.2–T2D.9, conflicts, documented actions and existing scoring outputs.
guard: Use issuer actions and the recorded scoring method only; gaps are not adverse conclusions. Keep legal capacity, willingness and financing feasibility separate.

title: Prior versus current financial results
inputs: T1B.1 paired revenue, EBITDA, cash flow/capex, comparable perimeter and duration.
guard: EU.1 has no bound figure producer. Pair only compatible quantities; margin belongs on a separate percent panel. One pair is a comparison, not a trend.

title: Margin and operating KPI changes
inputs: T1B.1 margin plus sourced segment/KPI prior/current pairs where actually supplied.
guard: EU.2 needs a producer/geometry adapter. Current paired tables do not prove a segment-level KPI series exists. Percent change and percentage-point change remain distinct.

title: Changes and drivers
inputs: T1B.1/T1B.2 deltas and T1B.3 driver/guidance evidence.
guard: A delta can be shown directly. A causal waterfall requires a sourced, reconciled driver decomposition; endpoints alone do not provide it.

title: Earnings release, guidance and watch dates
inputs: Actual release/observation dates and explicitly scheduled updates; guidance ranges when supplied.
guard: Reporting-period end is not release date. No guessed next earnings date; no guidance range from unsupported narrative.

title: Research questions, answers and consumers
inputs: TDR.1/TDR.2 locked questions, named receivers, claims and located evidence; TDR.4 dossier answers.
guard: Show answered, contrary evidence, unresolved and outside scope; references are data, not instructions to fetch or execute.

title: Source support and contradiction
inputs: TDR.2/TDR.4 sources, claim support, contrary evidence and uncertainty.
guard: Do not infer confidence from citation counts. Preserve primary/secondary source distinctions and unverified URLs.

title: Sourced sector/issuer catalysts
inputs: Dated events from the dossier with publication date distinct from event date and named impacted consumer.
guard: The upload launcher does not enable open-ended CP-DR research. Plot only retained supplied evidence; date-free themes stay a watchlist.

title: Peer/transaction research coverage
inputs: TDR.3 candidate peers, TDR.5 alignment observations, TDR.6 located figures.
guard: CP-DR locates evidence; CP-1C owns normalization and comparison. Candidate inclusion is not a final peer ranking.

title: Issuer against peer range: percent metrics
inputs: T1C.1 inclusion and T1C.3–T1C.5 settled EBITDA margin and FFO/debt observations.
guard: RV.3a derives its displayed peer range from settled observations; preserve excluded peers, missingness and comparability. No hidden dispersion statistics.

title: Issuer against peer range: multiples
inputs: T1C.3–T1C.5 total leverage and coverage, with issuer/peer definitions.
guard: RV.3b keeps multiples separate from percentages. Do not calendarise or FX-convert peers in the renderer.

title: Comparable universe and outliers
inputs: T1C.1–T1C.8 inclusion, normalization, source tie-out and gap rows.
guard: Partly comparable peers retain their caveats; show population size and omitted fields. No equal-sized bubbles suggesting unknown weights.

title: Valuation evidence and basis selection
inputs: T1C.9–T1C.11 public comps/precedents, date windows, metric definitions and selected basis.
guard: No EV multiple if EV/EBITDA basis is missing; peers/precedents use their recorded 12/36-month eligibility rules. A valuation range is not a price target.

title: Issuer-to-supported EBITDA
inputs: T1D.1–T1D.4 add-backs, achievability/recurrence decisions, accepted/rejected amounts and reconciliation.
guard: Proposed graphic over existing tables, not EU.3. Missing acceptance remains unassessed; do not treat non-cash as non-recurring automatically.

title: Add-back quality
inputs: T1D.1/T1D.2 assessment categories, rationale and evidence.
guard: Display the actual categorical judgments; no invented quality score or probability.

title: Cash conversion and leverage restatement
inputs: T1D.5–T1D.7/settled cash-conversion and leverage output with issuer/house basis labels.
guard: Compare like units and periods; preserve reported CFO, proxy FCF and issuer-defined FCF distinctions.

title: Thesis, strengths and weaknesses
inputs: T2.7/T2.10 and key-findings/thesis/strengths/weaknesses registers.
guard: Retain analyst interpretation and source links. Do not turn argument counts into a credit score.

title: Credit-risk transmission
inputs: T2.1/T2.11 assessments, named risks, explicit mechanisms and limitations.
guard: Only stated causal links; use qualitative categories. Do not invent likelihood/impact coordinates for a heatmap.

title: Watch items and thesis invalidation
inputs: T2.11/T2.12 watch metrics, thresholds/conditions and evidence gaps.
guard: A threshold is a condition, not a dated event. Add to the calendar only if a review date is explicitly supplied.

title: Base/downside/stress comparison
inputs: T2B.1–T2B.5 selected base period, static shocks, EBITDA, cash interest and credit metrics.
guard: This owner is a static single-period stress. Plot discrete computed cases; no invented time path, continuous response surface or mitigation.

title: First-break ranking and cushions
inputs: T2B.6–T2B.8 break levels, required decline, outcome and ranking.
guard: Keep legal covenants, analyst watch levels and rating triggers visibly distinct; do not add headrooms with different units.

title: Stress assumptions and what breaks first
inputs: Recorded scenario assumptions, test outcomes and explicit analytical explanation.
guard: Branches describe computed conditions, not probabilities. No forecast date from a static stress.

title: Sources and uses / liquidity bridge
inputs: T2E.1/T2E.3 settled bridge points and accessible liquidity components.
guard: Use the module’s signed values and timing; preserve restricted/trapped cash and uncertain facility access. The chart never recomputes a bridge.

title: Cash runway and minimum liquidity
inputs: T2E.2/T2E.3 liquidity position/runway and any supplied observation periods/minimum.
guard: No monthly path from an annual total. Cash runway is conditional on the stated operating-inflow and mandatory-use assumptions.

title: Maturities, uses and funding dates
inputs: T2E.4 maturities, dated obligations and T2E.5 funding-gap windows.
guard: Maturity is not a refinancing commitment. Avoid double-counting the same facility from CP-1 and CP-3C.

title: Accessible versus restricted resources
inputs: T2E.1/T2E.2 source amount, currency, jurisdiction/entity, availability and restrictions where provided.
guard: No gross cash-to-accessible-cash assumption; never aggregate currencies without a supplied conversion.

title: Rate shock before/after hedging
inputs: Produced T2F.1–T2F.5 baseline, up to three upward rate shocks, interest/coverage/FCF and hedge effects.
guard: Current method is a static upward parallel shock and requires the supported floor convention. Do not draw a symmetric tornado or negative-rate extrapolation. T2G.* remain registered but unproduced.

title: Currency shock exposure
inputs: T2F.4 specified currency moves, debt/EBITDA changes and leverage.
guard: Keep transaction, translation and financing exposures distinct where supplied; no continuous surface or unsourced correlation.

title: Hedges and residual risk
inputs: T2F.5 hedge terms and dated expiries/notionals if actually retained.
guard: Notional is not effectiveness or fair value. No expiry chart without dates; broader hedge term data may require an input extension.

title: Forward debt, cash and credit metrics
inputs: T2H.2–T2H.6 annual base/downside operating, debt/cash and metrics.
guard: Current model is three annual forecast years with documented no-new-borrowing/refinancing and other simplifications; do not add quarterly troughs or management mitigation.

title: Deleveraging and break-point timing
inputs: T2H.7/T2H.8 first affected year, path and thresholds.
guard: Fiscal-year bands are not exact calendar dates. Use a separate projected lane; no numeric probability.

title: Assumption and scenario comparison
inputs: T2H.3 assumptions, CP-2A persistent shocks, repayment/distribution/minimum-liquidity choices.
guard: Do not imply an assumption was issuer guidance or a scenario was an observed outcome.

title: Rating-trigger headroom
inputs: T2R.3–T2R.5 agency thresholds, direction, compatible metric basis and source.
guard: DR.6 currently produces only an unavailable frame and explicitly expects a synthetic-source limitation. A real-source/agency-adjusted producer needs qualification; no rating probability is permitted.

title: Agency divergence and migration view
inputs: T2R.2/T2R.7/T2R.8 issuer/instrument rating, agency, outlook, as-of and stated migration view.
guard: Rating notches are ordinal, not equal default-probability intervals. Withdrawn/unrated stay distinct; no unsupported rating history.

title: Published rating actions and projected triggers
inputs: Source-dated actions/reviews and T2R.6 forecast trigger year.
guard: Separate observed action, scheduled review and modelled trigger. History is not currently produced; require an explicit historical handoff before drawing it.

title: Security comparison and preference
inputs: T3.1/T3.3/T3.5/T3.7/T3.9 market evidence, instrument terms, risks and recorded preference.
guard: Separate loan/HY conventions and observed/indicative quotes. No invented total-return forecast or numeric preference score.
placement: FP01 relative value; FP03 instrument decision

title: Price, compensation and recovery case
inputs: CP-3 price and valuation judgments with CP-4C recoveries and CP-3D market terms when selected.
guard: Use only producer-defined comparable measures; keep estimated recovery and contractual claim separate. No legal seniority inferred from quoted yield.

title: Instrument optionality and catalyst dates
inputs: Sourced maturity, call/put, coupon/reset and offer deadlines with security identity.
guard: Do not create coupon schedules or option-exercise assumptions in delivery. Unknown dates remain unplaced.

title: Refinancing need by maturity
inputs: T3D.1 settled maturity/funding-need points and supplied resources.
guard: CR.3 needs exact maturity and funding basis. No committed refinancing from a suggested path; no double-counting shared resources.
placement: FP04 funding gap; FP05 funding gap/LME

title: Refinancing burden and cost sensitivity
inputs: T3D.2/T3D.3 burden/cost outputs and explicit stress assumptions.
guard: Scenario financing costs are not executable quotes; preserve currency, call costs, fees and missing terms.

title: Refinancing and LME alternatives
inputs: T3D.4–T3D.7 creditor position, LME capacity, paths and judgments; CP-4 legal conditions.
guard: Legal capacity, demonstrated willingness and market feasibility are separate. Do not convert possible paths into dated commitments.

title: Execution windows and decision deadlines
inputs: Source-dated maturities/call windows, explicit deadlines and analyst review milestones.
guard: Show analyst milestones separately from contractual deadlines; preserve contingent triggers.

title: Yield against maturity
inputs: T3E.* compatible instrument yield/spread, maturity, quote date and source class.
guard: RV.1 needs a bound producer and numeric-maturity geometry; the generic categorical line renderer is not an equivalent scatter plot. Do not mix YTM, discount margin and spread on one scale.

title: Market-implied versus fundamental risk
inputs: T3E.1–T3E.9 stated recovery/horizon assumptions, market inputs and computed implied-risk outputs.
guard: Label model-implied under stated assumptions; not an objective default forecast or a CP-2H migration probability. Respect observed/indicative and stale quote states.

title: Trading technicals and quote evidence
form: Quote/technicals matrix; history only if supplied
inputs: T3E.2–T3E.10 bid/offer, time, source and technical assessments.
guard: A single quote does not make a historical trend. No fabricated price series or interpolation through stale observations.

title: Covenant tests and headroom
inputs: T4.9 settled threshold/current/headroom and comparison text; T4C.6–T4C.8 definitions/binding.
guard: Current CR.1 accepts the defined ceiling/floor forms; preserve quantity/strictness and metric identity. A chart does not issue a legal compliance opinion.

title: Capacity, baskets and conditions
inputs: T4.10, T4D.6, T4F.3 headroom trace and governing definitions.
guard: Do not add overlapping/shared baskets. Separate legal capacity from cash availability and documentary facts from interpretation.

title: Entities, guarantees and structural subordination
inputs: T4D.2 governing entities; broader CP-4B handoff for obligors, guarantees, collateral and structural claims.
guard: Current narrow registers alone do not establish a complete entity/security graph. Require explicit edges, applicable document and jurisdiction.

title: Intercreditor ranking and control
inputs: Broader CP-4D executed ICA handoff: claim pools, payment/security ranks, enforcement, standstill and releases.
guard: Economic ranking and enforcement control are different; no numerical recovery without CP-4C inputs. This alias duty is broader than the current settled slice.

title: Tests, cures, amendments and notice deadlines
inputs: T4D.3 dates/amendments, executed terms and explicit test/notice/cure triggers.
guard: Plot fixed deadlines only when the source or legal module establishes the triggering date and calculation. Otherwise display the relative condition.

title: Creditor protections and red flags
inputs: T4.11/T4.13, T4F.4 scoring basis and facility/document coverage.
guard: Use only the recorded protection method; no radar chart implying undisclosed weights or complete coverage.

title: Recovery by class and scenario
inputs: T4E.5 class/scenario recovery and claim identity, linked T4E.2–T4E.4/T4E.9.
guard: Cap only as the owner computes; preserve entity/collateral pools and legal limitations. Do not turn the single-EV slice into a complete multi-entity waterfall.

title: Value allocation: supplied scenario 1
inputs: T4E.3/T4E.4/T4E.9 valuation row 1, costs, available value and distributions.
guard: Scenario identity comes from its source row. The current producer maps up to three rows in order; do not invent absent downside/stress cases or assume a legal pool order.

title: Value allocation: supplied scenario 2
inputs: T4E.3/T4E.4/T4E.9 valuation row 2, costs, available value and distributions.
guard: Scenario identity comes from its source row. The current producer maps up to three rows in order; do not invent absent downside/stress cases or assume a legal pool order.

title: Value allocation: supplied scenario 3
inputs: T4E.3/T4E.4/T4E.9 valuation row 3, costs, available value and distributions.
guard: Scenario identity comes from its source row. The current producer maps up to three rows in order; do not invent absent downside/stress cases or assume a legal pool order.

title: Fulcrum, attachment and plan treatment
inputs: T4E.2/T4E.6–T4E.8 claim balances, attachment/detachment, fulcrum and plan treatment.
guard: No double-counting guarantees; different pools may have different marginal rank. Conditional plan terms are not realised recoveries.

title: Material-claim support and gaps
inputs: T5.1–T5.9 and T5B.1–T5B.8 evaluated set, citations, resolutions and support verdicts.
guard: Denominator is the explicit evaluated/required set. Unassessed differs from unsupported. A support count is not a financial completeness or credit score.

title: Contradictions and lineage
inputs: Claim/source IDs, cross-module contradictions, exact source versions and derived-fact identities.
guard: Use labelled edges for support, contradiction and unresolved. No automatic causal or confidence weight based on edge count.

title: Findings and remediation
inputs: Findings, severity, affected consumer, repair action, status and evidence pins.
guard: Group repeated consequences by root cause; keep critical unresolved issues visible. Do not inflate counts with repeated warning text.

title: Committee challenge and resolution
inputs: T6A.4/T6A.6/T6A.7, committee_challenge and final bias.
guard: Use the actual chair/analyst conclusions; no simulated votes, inferred agreement or averaged confidence score.

title: Action bias, conditions and monitoring
inputs: T6-FINAL, unresolved risks, evidence weighting, monitoring actions and CP-2 thesis references.
guard: Recommendation and sizing remain the module/user decision; diagramming is not trade execution. No completion from a generated memo alone.

title: Portfolio limit headroom
inputs: Selected portfolio inputs/evaluation results: current/proposed exposure, NAV denominator, applicable limits and instrument eligibility.
guard: PD.1 has no current bound figure producer. Shared portfolio evaluation provides values; CP-6 owns interpretation, delivery renders. CP-6A portfolio-debate tables are registered but not bound by current CP-6. No new analytical owner or invented holdings.
placement: FP06 Portfolio Fit; shared Fit destination

title: Catalysts and monitoring commitments
inputs: Explicit decision dates, assigned review dates, catalyst conditions and sources.
guard: Undated conditions stay a watchlist. A user-entered reminder is labelled separately from a sourced issuer event.

title: Report section changes
inputs: All five report sections table: section, prior → current, why/effect and evidence.
guard: Show Unchanged and Revised in the handoff’s words. A revised report section is not an issuer change.

title: Prior and current material changes
inputs: Material analytical changes table: item, prior deliverable, current deliverable, classification/effect and evidence.
guard: Keep values, periods, assumptions and sources as the handoff states them. Added content does not upgrade assurance or show the issuer improved.

title: Regressions and recheck
inputs: Unresolved regressions table, the CP-8 recheck table and the prior, current and repaired report identities.
guard: A closed request applies to that delivery revision. It does not resolve the underlying creditor evidence gap.

title: Seven-topic financial change screen
inputs: TL10.1–TL10.5: EBITDA, FCF, cash, total/net debt, leverage and coverage for two quarters in one fiscal year.
guard: Display exact current policy materiality and denominator-zero handling; no cross-issuer rank or invented multi-year history. Other Lite table families stay registered but unproduced.

title: Upgrade disposition and handoff
inputs: Material/Watch judgments, ranked items, next owner and explicit credit transmission.
guard: This is a bounded change screen, not a full credit/recovery/legal recommendation; show unsupported topics and unresolved downstream consumption.

title: Published model and calculation provenance
inputs: Accepted/restricted CP-1 facts, model destination, calculation JSON, publication/source hashes.
guard: Reuse the existing Model destination and chart data; do not rerun analytics solely for delivery. Current core publication is HTML/calculation JSON, not a workbook.

title: Shared chart collection and availability
inputs: Eligible figures S.1–S.6 and other selected-owner outputs, state, limitation and exact data revision.
guard: CP-MODEL publishes, it does not own every analytical chart. One source series is reused across destinations; no duplicate calculations.

title: End-to-end execution and delivery
inputs: Actual module states, source/handoff/delivery verification, selected plan and recorded timestamps.
guard: User instruction makes CP-OS the active orchestrator despite the older catalog label. This view observes that orchestrator; it is not a competing runner. Sequence-only data uses ordinal steps, not invented elapsed-time bars.

title: Budget and spend
inputs: Approved cap, actual recorded provider costs, bounded retries and unknown/pending costs.
guard: Unknown cost is not zero. Keep workflow completion, budget progress and credit assessment separate; approval precedes Start.

title: Issuer, run, revision and file navigation
inputs: Verified issuer/run identity, dates, artifact lineage, source/analysis/export file roles and revision relationships.
guard: Do not merge unrelated delivery records into one revision chain without evidence. Maintain issuer/run/as-of context when moving between visuals and files.

title: Pathway composition and visual eligibility
form: Six pathway front pages + availability index
inputs: Selected handoffs, preset blocks, registered figure producers and explicit gaps.
guard: Separate delivery replaces CP-MEMO; no extra memo analytical run. Existing six retained snapshots have only five narrative blocks and zero charts, not proof of populated visual delivery.

title: Cross-module issuer event calendar
inputs: EVT-01–EVT-09 event contributions from selected dated handoffs; see event contract.
guard: Aggregate already produced evidence; no new analysis, guessed dates or duplicate event counting. Keep scenario and historical/planned lanes distinct.

title: Export and source parity
inputs: Exact chart points/table values, source pins, periods, units, basis, limitations and available export formats.
guard: Standalone HTML embeds charts/fonts/symbol offline. Preserve archived originals and verify each new chart against its handoff; do not claim unsupported exports.
